integrity: The stated all-size proof uses exact two-step firing intervals, finite transfer-matrix identities and a pole calculation; linked verification source and recorded output are embedded. No independent external scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only primitive period-two orbits on labelled fan graphs and compares with labelled wheels; no other periods, transients or automorphism quotient are treated. The 1992 general source could not be inspected in full; historical-equivalence risk remains. Finite code tests supplement rather than establish the all-size proof.
title: A one-edge boundary response for primitive two-cycles in parallel chip-firing
